subject: Vendor onboarding: EIN attestation required for PO setup (Acme Innovations)
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@acme-innovations.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Innovations Finance <payables@acme-innovations.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Onboarding info for Redwood — W-9 attached / PO request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for confirming the onboarding kickoff this morning. Attached is our completed W-9 and bank remit (Acme_W9_signed.pdf). Can you advise next steps for PO creation? We need the PO to start the integration work next Friday (6/25).

Quick summary:
- Company: Acme Innovations LLC
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Billing contact: payables@acme-innovations.com

If you need a signed IRS letter or additional verification to validate the EIN, let me know and I can escalate on our side.

Best,
Daniel Park
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Acme Innovations
Attachment: Acme_W9_signed.pdf (PDF, 230 KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@acme-innovations.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding info for Redwood — W-9 attached / PO request

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for the W-9. Quick note from procurement: we need one additional item to clear the PO gate — an official EIN confirmation (IRS CP575, IRS letter, or a bank letter on bank letterhead that references the EIN). Our AP team flags W-9-only submissions when the EIN is new to our vendor table.

Can you provide one of the following:
- Scanned IRS CP575 or CP575 replacement letter OR
- Bank letter on official letterhead confirming the entity name and EIN OR
- A vendor portal link to a government lookup that shows the EIN

If you can’t get an IRS doc immediately, a bank letter will suffice for provisioning the purchase account. Once we have that, Ben will create the PO and we’ll route for signature.

Timeline note: if we receive the letter by EOD Thu (6/17), we can issue PO by Mon (6/21) and have the integration kick-off on 6/25.

Thanks — looping in Ben and Marissa for procurement/accounting.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
H: (415) 555-0123
From: Daniel Park <daniel@acme-innovations.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Innovations Finance <payables@acme-innovations.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 11:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding info for Redwood — EIN confirmation attached

Hannah —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is a scanned copy of the bank letter that confirms Acme Innovations LLC and the EIN (Acme_EIN_confirmation.jpg). The letter is on bank letterhead and includes the remittance account details — let me know if procurement needs the bank to add any specific language.

Also sharing a DocSend link to the notarized CP575 copy in case your AP team prefers that: https://docsend.com/d/acme-ein-2027

Can you confirm when the PO will be issued once you have the attachment? We’d like to confirm start-of-work dates with engineering.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Acme Innovations
Attachment: Acme_EIN_confirmation.jpg (JPEG, 410 KB)

Daniel / Hannah —

Thanks for sending the bank letter — that satisfies our EIN verification. I’ve created the purchase order and routed for internal approval. PO details below: 

- PO number: PO-3192
- Total (not-to-exceed): $48,000
- Payment terms: Net 45
- Delivery: Integration services (SOW A1)

Attached is the signed PO (PO_3192_Redwood.pdf). Next steps for Acme:
1) Please confirm the billing name exactly as it should appear on invoices.
2) Send the first invoice referencing PO-3192 to payables@redwood.com once work begins.
3) Add the PO number to your invoice PDF and wire instructions if different from the bank letter.

We have scheduled the internal kickoff for 6/25; engineering will send a calendar invite once your team confirms resource availability.

If you need an expedited payment path (shorter terms) for the initial milestone, reply and we can run a one-off approval.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Analyst, Redwood Inference
